q: Chemical reactions which involve oxidation as well as reduction processes simultaneously, are known as ____.
e: Chemical reactions which involve oxidation as well as reduction processes simultaneously, are known as redox reactions. Redox is electron transfer: oxidation is loss of electrons and reduction is gain of electrons.

q: The separate oxidation and reduction reactions are called ____.
e: The separate oxidation and reduction reactions are called half-reactions. The separate oxidation and reduction reactions are called.

q: Redox reactions require a track of each ____ to each atom in chemical reactions.
e: Redox reactions require a track of each electron to each atom in chemical reactions. Redox is electron transfer: oxidation is loss of electrons and reduction is gain of electrons.
